content.value_statement: Small US motor carriers must organize driver records, fuel tax inputs, and audit paperwork. This skill guides an AI assistant in drafting checklists and preparation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides drafting Driver Qualification file checklists referencing 49 CFR 391.51.
Outlines driver onboarding tasks involving Clearinghouse queries, consent, and pre-employment drug testing.
Frames IFTA preparation around jurisdiction mileage and fuel receipt inputs.
Guides drafting New Entrant Safety Audit readiness checklists.
Identifies medical certificates, annual MVRs, and UCR registrations as items requiring expiration tracking.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; scripts, extension source, and original package templates are absent.
No implemented portal integration, filing submission, persistent tracking, or scheduled reminders are included.
Regulatory claims, deadlines, testing rates, and tax rates require verification against current official sources.
Guidance targets US-domiciled carriers; Canadian, Mexican, and intrastate-only requirements need separate review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a driver onboarding checklist
use_cases.description: Draft a checklist of driver qualification documents and pre-dispatch verification tasks for human review.

use_cases.title: Organize quarterly IFTA inputs
use_cases.description: Group jurisdiction mileage and fuel receipt information, highlighting missing inputs before tax preparation.

use_cases.title: Review audit paperwork readiness
use_cases.description: Prepare a document inventory and unresolved questions for a New Entrant Safety Audit.

prompt_templates.title: Start a DQ checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a DQ file checklist for a newly hired interstate CDL driver. Mark requirements needing current official verification.

prompt_templates.title: Review onboarding gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this redacted onboarding inventory: [document list]. Separate missing documents, pre-dispatch checks, and questions for our safety manager.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare existing records with an onboarding checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare IFTA calculation inputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these quarterly mileage and fuel totals: [jurisdiction totals]. Identify missing inputs and calculation assumptions. Request verified tax rates before estimating obligations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize tax preparation inputs without submitting a return.

prompt_templates.title: Build an audit preparation plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this redacted fleet inventory: [records and dates]. Draft an audit readiness plan with owners, evidence gaps, and regulatory questions for professional review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate document review across a fleet.

output_examples.input: Our new driver inventory lists a CDL and medical certificate, but no other onboarding records. Draft a review checklist.
output: Inventory review: only the CDL and medical certificate are listed.
Confirm the DQ file requirements and identify missing application, driving record, safety history, and road test documentation as applicable.
Review applicable Clearinghouse consent and query requirements and pre-employment drug test status before dispatch.
Have the safety manager verify current requirements and document completion.

output_examples.input: We have quarterly mileage totals, but fuel receipts are incomplete. Can you prepare our IFTA inputs?
output: Reconcile total and jurisdiction mileage, fuel purchases, and evidence of tax-paid fuel.
Obtain the applicable quarter and verified jurisdiction tax rates before estimating liability.

best_practices: Verify current requirements, applicability, and rates with FMCSA, IFTA authorities, or a qualified compliance professional.
Use redacted document inventories and jurisdiction totals instead of uploading unnecessary personal driver information.
Assign a human reviewer to confirm documents, calculations, and official submissions.
anti_patterns: Treating generated checklists as legal advice or a guarantee of passing an audit.
Assuming this guidance file submits filings, runs Clearinghouse queries, or maintains persistent records.
Reusing quoted deadlines or testing rates without checking the current rules and carrier applicability.

faq.question: What does this package include?
faq.answer: It includes SKILL.md guidance only. Scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are not included.

faq.question: Does it submit IFTA returns or run Clearinghouse queries?
faq.answer: No implemented submission or query integration is included. It can guide preparation, but authorized users must complete official actions separately.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The source describes compatibility with agents that support SKILL.md files.

faq.question: Are its regulatory claims guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. The guide claims June 2026 coverage, but provides no included verification mechanism. Check current official requirements before relying on generated output.

faq.question: Does it cover Canadian, Mexican, or intrastate-only operations?
faq.answer: The guide targets US-domiciled carriers. It excludes Canadian and Mexican operations and requires local verification for intrastate-only rules.

faq.question: Should I provide complete driver records?
faq.answer: Prefer redacted inventories and only necessary fields. Review your AI provider's data handling policies before sharing personal, medical, or testing information.
